IN THE COMMISSION FOR CONCILIATION, MEDIATION AND ARBITRATION

HELD AT JOHANNESBURG

Case No: GAJB1234-24

In the matter between:

T MOKOENA Applicant

ACME RETAIL (PTY) LTD Respondent

Commissioner: P N Sithole

Date of award: 14 March 2024

ARBITRATION AWARD

[1] This is an arbitration in terms of section 191(5)(a) of the Labour Relations Act 66 of 1995 (the LRA) concerning the dismissal of the applicant for misconduct.

[2] The applicant, identity number 8001015009087, was employed as a stock controller. His contact details on the referral were thabo.mokoena@example.co.za and 082 555 1234, and his residential address was 12 Jacaranda Street, Fictionville, 2001.

[3] The applicant was charged with theft of stock valued at R4 500. The respondent led CCTV evidence showing the applicant removing stock from the storeroom without authorisation.

[4] The applicant contended that his dismissal was unjustified and that other employees were not dismissed for similar conduct. No evidence was led of any similarly placed employee who had committed theft.

[5] The respondent's disciplinary code, which the applicant knew, provides that theft may warrant dismissal on a first offence. Theft goes to the heart of the relationship of trust.

[6] A disciplinary hearing was held, the applicant was represented by a shop steward, and he was given the opportunity to state his case. Item 4 of Schedule 8, the Code of Good Practice: Dismissal, was complied with.

AWARD

[7] I find that the dismissal of the applicant was substantively and procedurally fair.

[8] The application is dismissed.

COMMISSIONER P N SITHOLE
